hero.title: Send the room list. We confirm mattress height and GSM before sampling.
hero.description: A sample set goes on a bed first. Bulk starts after you sign the set and the logo proof. OEKO-TEX lots travel with the shipment when you ask for them.
hero.imageAlt: Hotel bedding program with layered linen

audiences.title: What housekeeping actually complains about.
audiences.description: These four show up after the first container, not on the quote.

items.title: Hotels
items.description: Towels go limp after the laundry. We lock GSM and loop density on a washed sample, not the unwashed quote towel.

items.title: Retailers
items.description: Replenishment white does not match last season. We keep the lot card so the next dye matches the signed set.

items.title: Developers
items.description: Fitted sheets do not cover the mattress. Drop and mattress thickness are written before we cut.

items.title: Product developers
items.description: Logo size is wrong only after bulk embroidery. Proof is stitched on the real terry first.

capabilities.title: Sheeting, terry, stitch, pack.
capabilities.description: Percale or sateen, thread count, and hotel sizes are set per room grade.

items.title: Bedding
items.description: Sets, duvets, pillows. Thread count and fitted-sheet drop on the SKU card.

items.title: Bath terry
items.description: 200–800 GSM. Feel is checked after wash, not only at finishing.

items.title: Embroidery
items.description: Size, thread and placement signed on a proof before the heads run.

items.title: Set packing
items.description: Cartons by room grade or colorway, piece count on the list.

process.title: Room list, then a set on a bed.
process.description: Bulk waits for a signed sample set. Logo waits for a proof on terry.

steps.title: Send the room list
steps.description: Product, size, GSM, mattress height, embroidery, quantity.

steps.title: Lock the spec
steps.description: Fitted-sheet drop, GSM after wash, room grade.

steps.title: Sample the set
steps.description: On a bed. Logo on the actual towel. About 12 days.

steps.title: Sign, then make
steps.description: Stitch, finish, set completeness on the line.

steps.title: Count and ship
steps.description: Set count, packing list, certificates in the carton.

warranty.title: When a set, wash or logo misses the signed sample.

cases.question: If a set is incomplete
